sub_sections: Project Name	PHAROS
Client	DAVITA
Role	Java Developer
Skills used	Java, java8, spring, spring boot , React.js.
Team Size	20	Markets: USA
Project Description:

Pharos is an enterprise application used by all DaVita clinics to submit and manage formulary exception requests for medication approval and ordering. A formulary exception refers to a medication or medical product that has restricted usage among patients and therefore requires special approval before it can be prescribed or ordered. Through Pharos, physicians submit exception requests, which are then reviewed and approved by the Clinical Pharmacy Management (CPM) team to ensure compliance with clinical guidelines and patient safety standards.The system streamlines the approval workflow, improves turnaround time, and ensures accurate tracking of approved medications across clinics.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Designed, developed, and maintained enterprise healthcare applications using Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Microservices architecture
Built and exposed secure RESTful APIs to support formulary exception request submission, review, and approval workflows
Developed responsive and user-friendly UI components using React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3
Implemented end-to-end workflow automation to route formulary exception requests to the Clinical Pharmacy Management (CPM) team
Integrated application services with relational and NoSQL databases to manage patient, medication, and approval data
Implemented authentication and authorization using Spring Security, JWT, and role-based access control to protect sensitive healthcare data
Ensured compliance with healthcare standards and security best practices including data privacy and audit logging
Implemented unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito to ensure application reliability and code quality
Used Swagger / OpenAPI for API documentation and service validation
Managed build and dependency configurations using Apache Maven and Gradle
Collaborated with clinical stakeholders, business analysts, and QA teams to understand requirements and deliver compliant solutions
Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives
Used Git, GitHub/Bitbucket, and JIRA for version control, collaboration, and issue tracking
Supported CI/CD pipelines and assisted with deployments on Linux and cloud environments
Performed bug fixing, performance optimization, code reviews, and production support

Project Name		DPP
Client	Davita
Role	Java Developer
Skills used	Java, java8, spring, spring boot, React.js, Camunda BPMN
Team Size	30	Markets: USA
Project Description

DaVita Placement Portal (DPP) is a web-based application used to manage patient referrals to hospitals and healthcare facilities. The portal collects patient demographics, clinical details, and medical records, and securely shares this information with downstream systems to enable referral processing. It is used by external hospital discharge planners to submit referrals and by DaVita Guest Services (DGS) users to manage operations and assist patients with hospital placement.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Designed and developed backend services using Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Microservices architecture
Built secure RESTful APIs to collect, validate, and transmit patient referral and medical data to downstream systems
Developed responsive user interfaces using React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 for external and internal users
Implemented role-based access control for external discharge planners and internal DGS users
Integrated applications with databases to manage patient, referral, and hospital placement data
Implemented authentication and authorization using Spring Security and JWT
Ensured secure data exchange and compliance with healthcare data privacy standards
Wrote unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito
Used Swagger/OpenAPI for API documentation
Collaborated with business, QA, and operations teams in an Agile/Scrum environment
Managed source code using Git/GitHub or Bitbucket and tracked work using JIRA
Performed bug fixes, enhancements, and production support
